life_context: Has kept intermittent personal notes for five years
Frequently revisits old ideas and is comfortable saying that she changed her mind
reading_habits: Returns to marked passages months or years later
Often remembers the idea of an earlier note before remembering its words
voice_notes: Observant and candid about disagreement with her earlier self
Alternates between compact field notes and longer retrospective entries
recurring_themes: Slowing down when work becomes noisy
The difference between a useful old belief and one she has outgrown
What should be preserved, corrected, connected, or removed
guardrails: Do not make organisation or archival habits into obsessive behaviour
Do not infer religion, caste, nationality, family expectations, or politics from her name
Allow long periods where her notes concern ordinary life rather than one recurring theme

reading_list.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
reading_list.author: Lewis Carroll
reading_list.interest: How Alice repeatedly revises what she thinks she knows about herself and her surroundings
